name: Error page
summary: The full-page error — an error code (404 · 403 · 500 · offline · generic) mapped to a DS Result with British-English copy, an optional action, role=alert and a telemetry event.
highlights: Full-page error mapped from a code: 404, 403, 500, offline, generic
DS Result with British English copy and an optional action
lead: ONE custom element — <aha-error-page> — composed from the shipped <aha-result> and <aha-button>. `code` picks the state and its default copy, each of which names what failed, says why and gives a next step; the retryable codes (500 · offline · generic) carry a primary "Try again" action. heading / body / action-label override the defaults with your translated strings, and action-label="" drops the button. The host is role="alert" so the failure is announced, fires `error-page-view` { code } once per code for telemetry, and `action` { code } when the button is pressed. Fills the viewport by default; `contained` fits it to a parent box.
codeNote: Map your router / fetch failures to a code and render this — never a bespoke "Something went wrong" div. Listen for error-page-view to report the error, and action to retry or navigate.

spec.label: Layout
spec.value: centred column, max 480 wide · fills the viewport (100dvh) or its parent with `contained` · 24/16 padding

spec.label: Action
spec.value: primary <aha-button size="lg"> (40px) — default "Try again" for 500 / offline / generic; none for 404 / 403 unless action-label is set

spec.label: A11y
spec.value: host role=alert — the failure is announced on arrival

spec.label: Telemetry
spec.value: error-page-view { code } once per code · action { code } on press

props.name: code
props.desc: Error code → state + default copy; unknown codes fall back to generic

props.name: heading
props.desc: Override the title (pass your translated string)

props.name: contained
props.desc: Fit the parent box instead of the viewport

whenToUse.when: the WHOLE page or respondent view cannot render — not found, no access, server or network failure
reporting the outcome of an action inside a page
part of the page failed but the rest still works
nothing failed — there is simply no content yet

opinion.note: An error page names what failed, gives a cause and offers a next step — never a bare "Oops!" or "Something went wrong". Keep failure and emptiness distinct: no data is an Empty state, not an error. Replaces the aha-design plugin's aha-design-shared-components registry entry (SHARED-06); the copy follows the ux-writing guideline.
opinion.dsv3: Composed from the DS V3 Result (status glyphs 404 / 403 / 500) and Button; no separate DS V3 frame.

snippets.label: HTML
snippets.note: The native form — a web component in an HTML file renders on open, no build step.

selfCheck.label: code → DS Result state + British-English copy
retryable codes carry a primary Try again; 404 / 403 do not
error-page-view + action events fire with the code

conformance.$about: Measured by qa.mjs against the RENDERED UI. The [data-probe] is a contained 404 (no default action); the [code="500"] sibling proves the retry action renders as a primary DS button.
